title: Three Men One Heart- Thumbs UP Spot

segments.x: Three men, one heart, any means necessary to connect to the warm unconditional love of the people of the United States of America. The pursuit of love, happiness, and freedom sought through riding trains, boats, automobiles, but more importantly, riding the kind vibrations of love from our fellow humans. Step outside your head and into our hearts as we find all
that's good in the USA. Thumbs up America and see you on the other side.
